mainEntity.name: How much does a Toyota Aygo X 1.0 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A replacement 1KR-B52 engine for the Toyota Aygo X 1.0 typically costs £872-£1,800 for the engine alone (supply-only). With supply and fit, budget £1,800-£2,800 for a fully installed rebuilt unit with warranty. Used engines start from around £872. Supply-only used 1KR-B52: from £872. Supply-only reconditioned 1KR-B52: from £1,200. Fully fitted rebuilt 1KR-B52: £1,800-£2,800.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump failure in a Toyota Aygo X 1.0?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common signs are coolant loss, a sweet smell from the engine bay, and visible coolant leaks around the water pump area. Some owners have reported water pump failure at as little as 10,000 miles. If left unaddressed, this can lead to overheating and engine damage. Coolant loss with no visible external leak. Sweet smell from engine bay. Overheating warning light.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Toyota Aygo X 1.0?

acceptedAnswer.text: With a typical Aygo X 1.0 worth £11,000-£15,000, replacement cost should be evaluated against vehicle value. For low-mileage cars, individual component replacement (e.g. water pump, throttle body) is usually more cost-effective. For high-mileage vehicles or those with internal damage, a rebuilt 1KR-B52 with 12-month warranty makes financial sense. Vehicle under £10,000: consider used engine or component repair. Vehicle £10,000-£15,000: rebuilt engine with warranty is viable. A rebuilt 1KR-B52 includes upgraded components and warranty.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Toyota Aygo X 1.0 1KR-B52 engine last?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper maintenance - regular oil changes and coolant checks - the 1KR-B52 engine can exceed 100,000-150,000 miles. The engine is known for its durability and is used across multiple Toyota and PSA models with good reliability records. Expected lifespan: 100,000-150,000+ miles with good maintenance. Regular oil changes and coolant checks are critical. Address water pump issues promptly to prevent overheating.

mainEntity.name: Is the Aygo X 1.0 engine the same as the previous Aygo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Toyota Aygo X 1.0 uses the same 1KR-B52 engine as the later previous-generation Aygo models. This means engine compatibility extends across multiple models, including the Peugeot 108 and Citroën C1. However, always verify engine code and compatibility before purchasing a replacement. Same 1KR-B52 engine as previous Aygo. Also fitted to Peugeot 108 and Citroën C1. Engine code verification is essential.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Toyota Aygo X 1.0 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical 1KR-B52 engine replacement on a Toyota Aygo X 1.0 takes 2-3 working days for a specialist workshop. This includes engine removal, preparation, installation of the replacement unit, fluid changes, and testing. Supply-only orders are typically dispatched within 1-2 working days for nationwide delivery. Supply only: 1-2 days dispatch. Supply and fit: 2-3 working days at workshop. historyTimeline.h2: Toyota Aygo X 1.0 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Toyota Aygo X launched in March 2022 as a crossover-styled city car, replacing the standard Aygo hatchback. Built on the TNGA GA-B platform shared with the Toyota Yaris, the Aygo X retained the 1KR-B52 1.0-litre three-cylinder petrol engine from the previous Aygo models, offering a punchy and efficient powertrain for urban driving.

milestones.description: 1KR-B52, 1.0-litre petrol, 72hp - launched with the all-new Aygo X crossover city car
5-speed manual and CVT automatic transmissions available
1.0-litre petrol discontinued; replaced by 1.5-litre M15A-FXE hybrid

commonProblems.h2: Toyota Aygo X 1.0 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Toyota Aygo X 1.0 (1KR-B52) is a reliable and efficient city car engine, but like any modern petrol unit, it has its weak points. Water pump failure and cold-start issues are the most commonly reported problems. Rebuilt 1KR-B52 engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these common failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Water Pump Failure - Why the Toyota Aygo X 1.0 1KR-B52 Can Develop Coolant Leaks
problems.rootCause: Water pump failure has been reported on low-mileage Aygo X examples, with leaking seals causing coolant loss. The issue appears to affect some early production models and may be related to component quality.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace water pump, flush cooling system, refill coolant
repairOptions.longevity: If caught early before overheating occurs

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, fully rebuilt 1KR-B52 with new water pump and upgraded components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If engine has overheated or high-mileage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Toyota Aygo X 1.0 (2022-2024) is worth approximately £11,000-£15,000 depending on mileage, condition, and trim. For vehicles within warranty, water pump replacement should be covered by the manufacturer. For vehicles outside warranty, specialist replacement is significantly cheaper than dealer pricing. Full engine replacement is rarely justified for water pump failure alone unless overheating has caused internal damage.
problems.recommendation: If you notice coolant loss or a coolant smell from your Aygo X 1.0, have the water pump inspected promptly. If the vehicle is under warranty, use a Toyota dealer for a free replacement. For out-of-warranty cars, a specialist water pump replacement offers the best value.

problems.h4: Cold-Start & Idle Issues - Why the Toyota Aygo X 1.0 1KR-B52 Can Struggle to Fire
problems.rootCause: Some Aygo X owners report cold-start issues where the engine cranks but struggles to fire. This may be related to the electronic throttle body, fuel system, or ECU calibration.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Clean electronic throttle body, reset ECU adaptations
repairOptions.longevity: If issue is intermittent and no fault codes present

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Diagnose fuel pump, injectors, and pressure regulator
repairOptions.longevity: If cold-start issue persists after throttle body service

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, fully rebuilt 1KR-B52 with updated components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If engine has multiple issues or high-mileage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: For most Aygo X 1.0 owners, cold-start issues are a minor inconvenience rather than a catastrophic failure. With the vehicle worth £11,000-£15,000, investing in diagnostic work and a throttle body service (£80-£150) is a sensible first step before considering more expensive repairs.
problems.recommendation: If your Aygo X 1.0 struggles to start when cold, try turning the key to the ignition position and waiting a few seconds before starting. If the issue persists, have the electronic throttle body cleaned and ECU adaptations reset by a specialist. This resolves the majority of cold-start complaints.
